title: feat(extractors): Go support via the LanguageSpec registry
context:
One registry entry + tree-sitter-go (0.23 line, prebuilds for
win32/linux/darwin, rides the per-process temp-copy loader). Structs
classify as class, interfaces as interface, type specs and aliases as
type; package-qualified stdlib calls are filtered by a builtin
allowlist. Module-prefixed imports resolve through go.mod's module
path to exact package directories — no suffix guessing.

Implements roadmap dec_c3c9d0e191.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
 What changed: added
decision: Introduced src/extractors, test/indexer.test.ts, test/languages.test.ts, test/parse.test.ts: added readGoModulePath, firstGoFileInDir, resolveGoImport, goFixtureRepo, UserID, kindOf, sb; new dep(s): node:fs.
